_comment: Discipline profiles: how the shared engine treats each academic discipline. Data, not code: a new discipline is a new entry here. 'aliases' resolve the free-text discipline of a curriculum to a profile. 'knowledge_areas' and 'occupation_examples' are ORIENTATION for people reading the results (what the discipline is about); they are never used as demand evidence and never assert that a skill is required. 'industry_populations' lists the job-posting populations (population_id in the source manifest) that are relevant evidence of this discipline's demand; a curriculum whose discipline has none is analysed on its own curriculum and its industry analyses are reported NOT_APPLICABLE with the reason. Peer and reference curricula are compared only within the same profile. Two-letter forms that also name degrees or other disciplines ('ME' = Master of Engineering, 'CE' = Computer Engineering) are deliberately not aliases.
